scope: Administrative review allocation, not a discovery threshold or candidate classification. All production positions remain in the frame. Certainty original75 plus five compact low-known-context priority packets per region; positive-probability SRSWOR in every remaining nonempty region/score stratum. No post-draw proximity exclusion. Private aliases are generated separately with an unpublished permutation.
region_definition: Source-bound qualified mask hemisphere and census assignment, with an explicit extension path stratum; historical batch names are not regions.
ranking_definition: Within review region empirical percentile of A score / its own frozen cutoff, across qualified original records. Priority ranking proxy only, not a significance or discovery cut.
